en: Black-and-white postcard showing an image of Our Lady of Guadalupe framed in a stone or marble wall. The Virgin Mary stands with hands joined in prayer, surrounded by rays, wearing a star‑covered mantle. Around the central painting are small shields or coats of arms. Beneath the image there is Spanish text dedicating her as Queen of Mexico and Empress of America, mentioning the miracle at Lake Texcoco and Pope Pius XII with the date 12 de octubre de 1945. Additional plaques with text appear at the bottom.
